resume.name: Uday Pratap Singh Parihar
resume.headline: Full Stack Developer · Next.js / React Native
resume.summary: Full-stack developer focused on **shipping production features** across **web and mobile**, and building efficient automation systems. Hands-on experience building **LLM-powered products**, developing **agentic workflows**, and **reverse-engineering complex APIs** to solve integration challenges. Comfortable with **high-throughput systems** and building reliable tools where documentation is limited. I dig into how systems work to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.

experience.title: Founding Engineer
bullets: Built and shipped a **React Native (Expo)** community app to the **App Store and Play Store**, now at **6,000+ registrations** with invite-only events running across **Delhi, Mumbai, New York and Dubai**.

Shipped booking, digital tickets, location-based member discovery with maps, push notifications and **OTP/OAuth authentication**, backed by an **Express + PostgreSQL** API with **EAS builds** and **over-the-air updates**.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Shipped production features and fixes across **web and mobile** (Next.js + React Native), improving chatbot UX and reliability on a live, customer-facing product.
Designed and built **agentic LLM workflows** in Dify, orchestrating multi-step model calls against a **BigQuery**-backed global trade-data store to ground answers in real data.
Extended the app's existing **data and services layer** to deliver **rich multimodal responses** - text alongside generated charts and graphs - directly inside the chat experience.

experience.title: Founding Engineer
bullets: Owned the **full stack** as first engineer on a platform serving **9,000+ users** and **100k+ shipments**: architecture, REST backend and database design, auth and role-based access, and external integrations.
Shipped **client and warehouse dashboards** turning live shipment data into actionable views for non-technical operations staff.
Integrated **partner and carrier systems** under international shipping compliance; handled deployment, monitoring and production support.

projects.name: EHR Integration Layer — eClinicalWorks
bullets: Reverse-engineered the platform's **client-side payload encryption** to make its undocumented endpoints callable — captured live traffic through an intercepting proxy, recovered the request/response encryption scheme, and reimplemented it outside the browser.

Built a **custom API wrapper** handling authentication and session state, exposing **UI-free** patient creation and appointment scheduling as clean programmatic calls where **no public API or SDK existed**.

projects.name: Field Operations Platform — FMCG distribution
bullets: Built a modern web and **Android/iOS** front end over a **legacy FoxPro/DBF** ERP — a custom **DBF ORM** reads and writes the original data files, so the existing desktop software keeps running unchanged alongside it.

Shipped invoicing, stock transfers and reporting with **real-time** Socket.IO updates, plus a **WhatsApp AI agent** (Gemini) — a standalone webhook service answering queries against **live ERP data** and converting catalogue messages into confirmed orders.

projects.name: High-Throughput E-commerce Automation — Myntra, Flipkart
bullets: Built restock/price monitors and a request-driven bulk checkout engine at **under 2 s per order and 500+ concurrency**, with a centralized dashboard on **GCP Cloud Run** and automated card payments with **3DS/OTP** handling via custom companion app.
